name: Gallegos de Solmirón (Spain)
description: White field within a black dancetty border, charged at the centre with a horizontal processional cross of grey and black with scallop shells, bearing the municipal arms at its centre.
history: Municipal flag of Gallegos de Solmirón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: processional cross lying horizontally with scallop shells at its ends
Gallegos de Solmirón arms — small shield at the centre of the cross
